Bullet train corridor approved connecting Delhi and Guwahati

A bullet train corridor connecting Delhi and Guwahati has been approved, with Assam Chief Minister Himanta Biswa Sarma confirming the extension of the service to Assam. The project is expected to reduce travel time between the two cities to under 8 hours. The corridor will link 10 major cities.
